function.arguments: {"observation": "`arm` and `severity` are strongly associated: clinicians preferentially assigned the treatment arm to more severe patients. This means the treatment and control groups are not comparable on baseline severity.", "implication": "Although the current estimand is only about the treatment arm (not a comparison between arms), the question asks for the response fraction within the treatment arm only. Since the treatment arm is not a representative sample of all patients (it is enriched for severe cases), the response fraction may be biased. However, the estimand does not require comparison to another group — it is purely descriptive of the treatment arm. Thus, no adjustment is needed for `severity` in this case, because we are not making a causal claim or comparing groups. The finding does not change the analysis plan."}
function.name: note_finding
